definition: The distance from the top to the bottom of something; how deep it is.
examples: The pool has a depth of two meters.
The depth of the lake is unknown.
She was surprised by the depth of his voice.

spanish.definition: Distancia desde la superficie hasta el fondo de algo.

definition: A child whose parents have died.
examples: The orphan lives with his grandmother.
They adopted an orphan from another country.
The orphan missed his parents very much.

spanish.definition: Niño cuyos padres han muerto.

definition: Strong cloth used for painting or for making tents and bags.
examples: The artist painted a flower on the canvas.
The bag is made of strong canvas.
She bought a new canvas for her art class.

spanish.definition: Tela fuerte que se usa para pintar o para hacer tiendas y bolsos.

definition: A very young cat.
examples: The kitten sleeps in a small box.
Our cat had three kittens.
She gave the kitten some milk.

spanish.definition: Gato muy joven.

definition: A person who gives expert advice to a company.
examples: The company hired a consultant to help with the project.
My aunt works as a consultant in London.
The consultant gave us some useful advice.

spanish.definition: Persona que da consejos expertos a una empresa.

definition: The art of designing buildings; the style of a building.
examples: She studies architecture at the university.
I love the old architecture of this city.
The architecture of the new museum is very modern.

spanish.definition: Arte de diseñar edificios; estilo de un edificio.

definition: Something you give or do to help a group or a cause.
examples: Everyone made a small contribution to the gift.
His contribution to the project was very important.
Thank you for your contribution to the team.

spanish.definition: Algo que se da o se hace para ayudar a un grupo o una causa.

definition: A strong vehicle used on a farm to pull machines.
examples: The farmer drives a tractor in the field.
The tractor is pulling a heavy trailer.
We saw a red tractor on the farm.

spanish.definition: Vehículo fuerte que se usa en el campo para arrastrar máquinas.

definition: Moral rules about what is right and wrong.
examples: The doctor always follows medical ethics.
We talked about ethics in my philosophy class.
Business ethics are important for every company.

spanish.definition: Reglas morales sobre lo que está bien y lo que está mal.

definition: A person who repairs water pipes.
examples: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
We called a plumber because the sink was leaking.
My uncle is a plumber.

spanish.definition: Persona que repara tuberías de agua.

definition: A line or road that bends; to bend.
examples: The road has a sharp curve near the school.
The road curves to the left after the bridge.
Draw a curve on the paper.

spanish.definition: Línea o camino que se dobla; doblar.

definition: A container used for holding flowers.
examples: She put the flowers in a glass vase.
The vase fell and broke.
There is a beautiful vase on the table.

spanish.definition: Recipiente que se usa para poner flores.

definition: The traditions and culture that come from the past.
examples: The city is proud of its cultural heritage.
We must protect our national heritage.
This dance is part of our family heritage.

spanish.definition: Tradiciones y cultura que vienen del pasado.

definition: A person who catches fish.
examples: The fisherman goes to sea early in the morning.
An old fisherman told us a story.
The fisherman sold his fish at the market.

spanish.definition: Persona que pesca.

definition: The feeling of being thankful; understanding the value of something.
examples: She showed her appreciation with a small gift.
I have great appreciation for your help.
The teacher smiled to show her appreciation.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de gratitud; reconocimiento del valor de algo.

definition: A person who follows someone secretly and frightens them.
examples: The police caught the stalker near her house.
She felt safe after the stalker was arrested.
A stalker was following the singer.

spanish.definition: Persona que sigue a alguien en secreto y le da miedo.

definition: The ability to keep a secret or act carefully.
examples: Please use discretion with this private information.
The nurse spoke with great discretion.
You can trust his discretion.

spanish.definition: Capacidad de guardar un secreto o actuar con cuidado.

definition: Machines together, especially in a factory.
examples: The factory is full of heavy machinery.
Workers must be careful around machinery.
The machinery makes a loud noise.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de máquinas, especialmente en una fábrica.

definition: A long orange vegetable that grows under the ground.
examples: The rabbit is eating a carrot.
I put carrots and potatoes in the soup.
Carrots are good for your eyes.

spanish.definition: Verdura larga y naranja que crece bajo tierra.

definition: The act of becoming involved to help or change a situation.
examples: The doctor's intervention saved the child's life.
The teacher made an intervention to stop the fight.
The government announced an intervention in the market.

spanish.definition: Acción de participar para ayudar o cambiar una situación.

definition: A person who studies a subject deeply and knows a lot about it.
examples: He is a famous scholar of ancient history.
The scholar wrote many books about language.
She wants to become a scholar at the university.

spanish.definition: Persona que estudia mucho un tema y sabe mucho de él.

definition: Special skill or knowledge about a subject.
examples: We need someone with expertise in computers.
The doctor has years of expertise in this area.
Her expertise helped the team finish the work.

spanish.definition: Habilidad o conocimiento especial sobre un tema.

definition: A narrow piece of material used to hold or carry something; to tie something with it.
examples: The strap of my bag is broken.
He straps the box to the bike.
She wore a watch with a black strap.

spanish.definition: Tira estrecha de material para sujetar o llevar algo; atar con ella.

definition: The feeling of being ashamed or uncomfortable.
examples: He felt embarrassment when he forgot her name.
She blushed with embarrassment.
To avoid embarrassment, he said nothing.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de estar avergonzado o incómodo.

definition: A sweet flavor used in desserts and ice cream.
examples: I love vanilla ice cream.
Add a little vanilla to the cake.
The candle smells like vanilla.

spanish.definition: Sabor dulce que se usa en postres y helados.

definition: A small cloth used to wipe your nose or face.
examples: He took a handkerchief from his pocket.
She wiped her tears with a handkerchief.
This handkerchief has my initials on it.

spanish.definition: Tela pequeña que se usa para limpiarse la nariz o la cara.

definition: A person who changes words from one language to another.
examples: The translator helped them at the meeting.
She works as a translator from English to Spanish.
We need a good translator for this document.

spanish.definition: Persona que pasa palabras de un idioma a otro.

definition: The feeling of friendship and support between people.
examples: The soldiers felt a strong brotherhood.
The club is based on brotherhood and respect.
They share a brotherhood that lasts a lifetime.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de amistad y apoyo entre personas.

definition: Related to school or study; a person who teaches at a university.
examples: She has a strong academic record.
The academic year starts in September.
He is a respected academic.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la escuela o el estudio; persona que enseña en una universidad.

definition: An animal that hunts and eats other animals.
examples: The lion is a dangerous predator.
Small animals hide from predators.
This bird is a predator that eats mice.

spanish.definition: Animal que caza y come otros animales.

definition: A thick, sweet liquid.
examples: She put syrup on her pancakes.
The medicine is a sweet syrup.
Mix the sugar and water to make syrup.

spanish.definition: Líquido espeso y dulce.

definition: A group of companies or criminals that control a market.
examples: The police arrested leaders of the drug cartel.
The cartel controls the price of oil.
Several companies formed a cartel.

spanish.definition: Grupo de empresas o criminales que controla un mercado.

definition: The act of stopping something for a time; a part that holds a vehicle.
examples: The player received a suspension after the fight.
The suspension of classes lasted one week.
The car has a new suspension.

spanish.definition: Acción de detener algo por un tiempo; pieza que sostiene un vehículo.

definition: The change from one state or situation to another.
examples: The transition from school to work can be difficult.
We are in a period of transition.
The transition to the new system was smooth.

spanish.definition: Cambio de un estado o situación a otro.

definition: The act of looking at two things to see how they are similar or different.
examples: The comparison between the two cars was useful.
In comparison with her sister, she is very quiet.
The report includes a comparison of the prices.

spanish.definition: Acción de mirar dos cosas para ver en qué se parecen o se diferencian.

definition: A student in the first year of high school or university.
examples: My brother is a freshman at the university.
Every freshman has a meeting today.
She met her best friend in her freshman year.

spanish.definition: Alumno del primer año de secundaria o universidad.

definition: A large formal meal for many people.
examples: The hotel prepared a banquet for the wedding.
We attended a banquet in the city hall.
The banquet lasted three hours.

spanish.definition: Comida grande y formal para muchas personas.

definition: A small brush used to clean your teeth.
examples: I need a new toothbrush.
She put toothpaste on her toothbrush.
Pack your toothbrush before the trip.

spanish.definition: Cepillo pequeño que se usa para limpiar los dientes.

definition: Rude and offensive; not polite.
examples: That joke was vulgar and made people uncomfortable.
He used vulgar language in front of the children.
Please don't write vulgar words here.

spanish.definition: Grosero y ofensivo; no educado.

definition: The act of becoming better or making something better.
examples: There is a clear improvement in your English.
The company made improvements to the website.
We need to see an improvement in the results.

spanish.definition: Acción de volverse mejor o de hacer algo mejor.

definition: A shop where bread and cakes are made and sold.
examples: I buy fresh bread at the bakery every morning.
The bakery near my house sells delicious cakes.
She works in a small bakery.

spanish.definition: Tienda donde se hace y se vende pan y pasteles.

definition: The act of accepting someone into a place or group; a fee to enter.
examples: The admission to the museum is free on Sundays.
His admission to the university made the family happy.
Admission to the concert costs twenty dollars.

spanish.definition: Acción de aceptar a alguien en un lugar o grupo; precio de entrada.

definition: A short piece of writing about a subject.
examples: I have to write an essay for my English class.
Her essay was about climate change.
He read his essay to the class.

spanish.definition: Texto corto sobre un tema.

definition: A feeling of extreme happiness.
examples: The fans were in ecstasy after the goal.
She felt ecstasy when she heard the news.
His face showed pure ecstasy.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de felicidad extrema.

definition: A shop where you buy medicine.
examples: I bought my medicine at the pharmacy.
The pharmacy is open until nine.
Ask the pharmacist at the pharmacy for help.

spanish.definition: Tienda donde se compran medicinas.

definition: The height of something above the sea.
examples: The plane flies at a high altitude.
The village is at an altitude of two thousand meters.
At this altitude, the air is thin.

spanish.definition: Altura de algo sobre el nivel del mar.

definition: Not able or not willing to speak; to turn off the sound.
examples: He stayed mute and did not answer.
Please mute your phone in the cinema.
You can mute the television with this button.

spanish.definition: Que no puede o no quiere hablar; apagar el sonido.

definition: The last part of a show, concert or story.
examples: The finale of the concert was amazing.
Everyone sang together in the finale.
The film has a surprising finale.

spanish.definition: Última parte de un espectáculo, concierto o historia.

definition: A violent criminal.
examples: Two thugs stole his wallet.
The thugs ran away when the police arrived.
The shop was attacked by a group of thugs.

spanish.definition: Criminal violento.

definition: A person who has left their country because of war or danger.
examples: The refugee arrived with only one bag.
Many refugees need food and medicine.
The city opened a school for refugee children.

spanish.definition: Persona que ha dejado su país por la guerra o el peligro.
